_note: lb_rr scale-ramp: ONE DuckDB process (single BASE_URL) -> nginx third-party gateway (8500, round-robin, proxy_next_upstream off) -> 2 vLLM backends (8000/8001). The 2 vLLM processes have INDEPENDENT prefix caches and do NOT share (warming one does NOT warm the other). Protocol §2.6 classifies this as the gateway 完整系统轨 (system-level conclusions only, not DuckDB-native baseline, not formal-eligible; scheduler_owner = duckdb_ai_extension + nginx_round_robin + vllm). Scale is the only moving variable (calibration rule); concurrency frozen at C_total=64 (3-arm saturation: gate c=32/endpoint, project K=32/endpoint). Uses endpoint_count=1 lbrr_dev manifests (all rows -> LB). The 3 gate arms run separately on 2-endpoint squad_dev manifests. warmup_per_cell (when true) warms BOTH backends with the FULL prompt set via endpoint_index=0 (single-endpoint manifest) -- NOT 'backend 1 via shared cache' (caches are independent). This config sets warmup_per_cell=false because the lb_rr cell itself routes every request through nginx to both backends (cell-internal self-warming of both caches); a controlled cache-hot lb_rr run needs the single-endpoint warmup. PREREQUISITE: 256-row correctness gate FIRST (exactly-once; 0 error / no observed max_tokens-truncation -- empty finish_reason field ≠ 'audited non-length'; per-backend request-count + token-work skew) before trusting any throughput number.
